primary.title: Social Security: SSA retirement benefit checks due this week on 8 July — See who is eligible, amount and full schedule
primary.summary: July 8 social security distribution: The checks will be doled on pre-determined days this month based on your birth date. The benefit differs by retirement age, with up to $5,181 for those who delay claims until 70. Here's a look at the payment schedule…
